fields.value: PMP® Certified Project Manager | Technical Leadership | eCommerce & FinTech

PMP-certified Project Manager with a unique blend of technical expertise and strategic project leadership. 7+ years delivering eCommerce and FinTech solutions, progressing from a hands-on developer to managing $500K+ portfolios across 25 accounts. Strong foundation in Java, Spring Boot, AWS/GCP cloud architectures, and microservices enables effective stakeholder communication and swift technical decision-making. Currently leading 28+ professionals across 4 Agile teams with 98% on-time delivery and 95% client satisfaction. Skilled in risk mitigation, financial forecasting, and process improvement, achieving 20–30% faster delivery through data-driven methodologies.
Manage a $500K+ portfolio for 25 client accounts, utilizing financial forecasting to maintain zero budget overruns and a 95% NPS score.
Transformed client relationships into strategic partnerships, leading to multiple contract renewals and the approval of additional billable SOWs through transparent project governance.
Drive cross-functional alignment by translating complex technical constraints into business value for C-suite stakeholders.
Championed the use of automated JIRA dashboards and Excel trackers to increase delivery visibility by 40%, optimizing resource utilization across four Agile teams.
Spearheaded end-to-end delivery for North American eCommerce businesses, managing portfolios worth $300K+ with 98% on-time delivery.
Identified upsell opportunities during technical discovery phases, successfully converting project gaps into new billable SOWs.
Established a standardized code review process using SonarQube, reducing production bugs by 60% and shortening deployment cycles.
Orchestrated the transition of SMB clients to AWS and GCP cloud architectures, improving application performance and client trust.
Engineered scalable microservices and REST APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and Hibernate for high-traffic eCommerce applications.
Developed responsive, user-centric front-end components using JavaScript and Vue.js, improving engagement across client platforms.
Mentored junior developers on debugging efficiency and enforced high coding standards through SonarLint and comprehensive documentation.
Developed an AI-powered receivables platform using a full-stack Java/Ext.js architecture, supporting over 50 enterprise-level clients.
Reduced application response time by optimizing complex SQL queries and database indexing, cutting execution time by 19%.
Integrated Machine Learning models into production pipelines in collaboration with data science teams to automate credit risk assessments.
Collaborated with data science teams to integrate Machine Learning models into the production pipeline, reducing deployment time from days to hours.
Developed MLOps platform components using Java to enable real-time model predictions for credit risk assessment.
Designed intuitive UI components using JavaScript and ExtJS, increasing platform usability by 30% based on user feedback.
Developed autonomous receivables applications using React.js for two major financial services clients.
Created interactive dashboards and data visualizations using JavaScript, CSS3, and HTML5, resulting in a 25% increase in user engagement.
Ensured cross-browser compatibility and optimized front-end performance for complex financial data sets.
